name: catalog-service-example
description: POST /products indexes into OpenSearch; GET /search runs full-text + filtered queries; GET /stats aggregates; PUT /products/{id}/embedding + GET /products/{id}/similar run DynamoDB vector search (SearchVectors). Port 3634 (invoke 13634). The OpenSearch handlers speak the REST API with Node's global fetch; the vector handlers use @aws-sdk v3 resolved from the repository root.
